messages:
aisha.s: Hey team, SOC/ISO audit request just came in — auditor wants evidence for RBAC changes, KMS key rotations, and related audit logs for 2024-01-01..2024-06-30. Who can pull exports?

bob_r: I can. Do they need raw logs or a packaged CSV with control mapping? :thinking_face:

aisha.s: They asked for both: raw event stream + a mapping doc that shows which events satisfy controls (A.9.2 / CC6.1 etc). Please include reviewer notes for each RBAC change.

carla_sre: For RBAC changes we have the GitChange records in terraform-state:terraform-cloud workspace. I can export the state changes and link them to PRs. Quick query I use: 
```bash
# list iam changes from audit log (GKE example)
jq -r '.entries[] | select(.protoPayload.methodName|test("SetIamPolicy|UpdateServiceAccount")) | [.timestamp,.protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail,.protoPayload.methodName,.protoPayload.request.resource] | @csv' gcp-audit-logs-2024.json
```
That gives a CSV we can attach.

dave_infra: For KMS, keys/rotation live in AWS KMS and our CMKs are in alias prefixes redwood-prod-*. I can pull key rotation history via: 
```bash
aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[].KeyId' | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id {} --output json
```
I can also export CloudTrail events filtered by EventName=RotateKey or CreateKey.

aisha.s: Good. Auditor also asked whether we use HSM-backed keys and whether envelope encryption is used for workloads in Private. Need a short written statement. @dave_infra can you confirm?

dave_infra: All production CMKs are created with AWS-managed HSM (AWS KMS). For Private deployments we use envelope encryption: data key encrypted with customer CMK, data key stored in vault encrypted at rest. I'll write a short note.

bob_r: One auditor question: do we have proof of periodic access reviews for RBAC roles (admin/service-account access)? I can attach the quarterly access review docs from People Ops if someone points me to the repo.

carla_sre: Access review artifacts are in /docs/compliance/access-reviews/2024-Q1-Q2.pdf in the compliance bucket. I can generate signed links.

compliance-bot: FYI — control mapping template: https://redwood-internal/*/control-mapping-template.xlsx (see sheet 'A9_RBAC_map'). Use column headers: ControlId, EvidenceFile, Description, Reviewer, ReviewDate.

aisha.s: Auditor also asked about a vulnerability triage that affected agent runtime in Feb (CVE-2024-2334). We performed a coordinated patch/rollback. Need timeline and postmortem excerpt. @sec-oncall had the incident notes.

sec-oncall: Timeline gist: 2024-02-11 02:14 UTC initial alert; 02:25 identified vulnerable lib; 03:10 mitigation (pin + hotfix); 04:00 full rollout. Postmortem stored in /incidents/2024-02-cve-2334-postmortem.md. I'll attach sanitized excerpt showing detection, decision, and rollback steps.

bob_r: For the audit logs export: do auditors want CloudTrail + application-level authz events? We log grant/revoke and token creation in the auth-service. Example query for token events: 
```sql
SELECT time, user, action, resource FROM auth_events WHERE action IN ('token.create','token.revoke') AND time BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30';
```
I can run and export as CSV.

aisha.s: Yes include both infra (CloudTrail/Stackdriver) and app auth logs. Also include hashed resource identifiers for PII safety.

carla_sre: Quick note about RBAC review notes: make sure to include PR link + approver + JIRA ticket. Audit wants proof of business justification. I can add a summary table like: 
- change_id: terraform-change-123
- pr: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1234
- approver: bob_r
- justification: service X needed access for feature Y (JIRA PROJ-789)

dave_infra: I'll gather KMS rotation JSON, CloudTrail exports, and a short HSM statement. Expect uploads to the evidence bucket by EOD.

aisha.s: Thanks. Auditor asked a clarifying question re: cross-account key usage — do we share CMKs with partners?

bob_r: No cross-account key sharing for customer-facing keys. We have separate keys per tenant in Private; partner integrations use asymmetric keys or transient tokens. I'll add a statement.

compliance-bot: Checklist reminder: Evidence package should include: 1) RBAC change CSV, 2) PRs + approver notes, 3) Access review PDFs, 4) KMS rotation export, 5) HSM/encryption statement, 6) Vulnerability triage excerpt, 7) Mapping sheet filled.

aisha.s: OK team — action items: @carla_sre export RBAC CSV + signed link, @bob_r export auth events + access review PDFs, @dave_infra KMS rotation + HSM statement, @sec-oncall postmortem excerpt. I'll assemble mapping sheet and submit to auditor. Please drop S3 links here when ready.

carla_sre: Uploading RBAC CSV -> s3://redwood-evidence/iso/2024/Q1Q2/rbac-changes-2024-01-06.csv :upload:

bob_r: Auth events CSV -> s3://redwood-evidence/iso/2024/Q1Q2/auth-events-jan-jun.csv ; access reviews -> s3://redwood-evidence/iso/2024/Q1Q2/access-reviews-Q1Q2.pdf

dave_infra: KMS rotation export -> s3://redwood-evidence/iso/2024/Q1Q2/kms-rotation.json ; HSM statement -> s3://redwood-evidence/iso/2024/Q1Q2/hsm-statement.md

sec-oncall: Postmortem excerpt -> s3://redwood-evidence/iso/2024/Q1Q2/cve-2334-excerpt.md

aisha.s: Perfect. I'll fill the mapping sheet and ping the auditor. If anyone sees a file with sensitive PII, flag and we'll redact before shipping. :thumbsup:

bob_r: Quick follow-up — auditor asked if logs were tamper-evident. We use CloudTrail + S3 object lock for the evidence bucket. I'll add the S3 bucket policy and object-lock config snippet.

carla_sre: Great. Closing loop once I have the signed links. Thanks team! :rocket:
